entry.title: New: Resolution 585 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE CORPORATION FOR NATIONAL AND COMMUNITY SERVICE, PURSUANT TO HAWAIʻI REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR A GRANT TO THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT

Allows for the receipt of $40,000 of federally-derived funds to provide community- based training and regional education from local historians, cultural practitioners, and other sources to AmeriCorps Volunteers in Service to America personnel.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 585-24 & FC-185 - 9/4/2024
